title: Invertibility on literal unshifted telescope cones
statement: Let f : Z → Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with derived categories in a common universe [def-pc-derived-category], F the recorded derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] supplied with a strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and additive termwise tensor pullback H [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write q for the homotopy quotient, Q_Y,Q_Z for the derived localizations, L=Q_Y⋙F, G=H^h⋙Q_Z. Let B be boundedFlatShiftRepresentative [def-sc-bounded-flat-shift-representative], T be flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative and let stage maps mean flatTelescopeStageMap [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. For a fixed e : F(𝟙_Y[1]) ≅ 𝟙_Z[1], set b_e(K)=F(c_Y(K)⁻¹);δ_F(𝟙_Y[1],K);(e⊗id);c_Z(FK), where c is the canonical translated-unit comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. Suppose a_X:LX→GX for X in T is natural for all homotopy morphisms between the representatives and satisfies a_{qP[1]};commShift_G(qP)=F(commShift_Q_Y(qP));b_e(Q_YqP);a_{qP}[1] for every literal flat telescope P. Suppose a_X is invertible whenever X also belongs to B. Then a_{qP} is invertible for every literal flat telescope P. This assertion takes the morphisms and their normalized shift square as input and does not construct them.

source.place: Sum and inverse-cone invertibility part of steps 1--3 of lem-sc-flat-telescope-bounded-normalization-extension; inherited agent expansion of the telescope model argument.

proof.text: Destruct the literal telescope as the cone of p=one minus transition on sum E. Apply the sum-comparison lemma to obtain a literal flat telescope R with q(sum E) isomorphic to qR and alpha(qR) invertible. The supplied normalized shift equation at R, together with invertibility of every comparison iso and of the shift of alpha(qR), proves alpha(qR[1]) invertible by cancellation. Conjugate these two components by the homotopy isomorphism and its shift to get invertible maps a at q(sum E) and a-prime at q(sum E)[1].

Read the existing triangulated structure of derivedPullback from the specification of exists_derivedPullback; use this structure, without identifying it with the normalized translated-unit comparison. Both L=Qh followed by derivedPullback and G=termwise pullback followed by Qh send the homotopy cone triangle of p to distinguished triangles. Transported naturality gives the four squares for p, the cone inclusion, the connecting morphism, and p[1]. The fourth vertical component d is the source shift comparison inverse, followed by a-prime and the target shift comparison. It is invertible but need not equal a[1]. The proved private cone_five_lemma applies to these five-term squares: cancellation and coyoneda exactness prove the cone component monic; lift the target connecting image through d, factor using source exactness, and correct the remaining error using invertibility of a. Yoneda bijectivity then proves the cone component invertible. This is all written in Lean and uses no new hole.

proof_origin.place: Sum step retained as a strict intermediate; explicit five-term Yoneda chase replaces the requirement that the transported comparison be a morphism of triangles.

theorem flat_telescope_normalization_unshifted_isIso
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive]
    (e : (derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
        (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (α : ∀ X : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X →
          ((DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).obj X ⟶
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
              (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                schemeDerivedCategory Z)).obj X))
    (hαnat : (∀ (X X' : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X) (hX' : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X')
          (s : X ⟶ X'),
          (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).map s ≫ (α X' hX') =
            (α X hX) ≫
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
                (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                  schemeDerivedCategory Z)).map s))
    (hαshift :
        ∀ (P : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (htel : isFlatTelescope Y P),
        let X := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P
        let G := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
            schemeDerivedCategory Z)
        (α (X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ⟨P, htel, Or.inr rfl⟩) ≫
            (G.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X =
          (derivedPullback f).map ((DerivedCategory.Qh.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X) ≫
            ((derivedPullback f).mapIso
                (schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Y (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)).symm ≪≫
              asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (derivedPullback f)
                ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)) ≪≫
              tensorIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
              schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Z
                ((derivedPullback f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X))).hom ≫
            (α X ⟨P, htel, Or.inl rfl⟩)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')
    (hαbounded : ∀ (X : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
      (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X),
      boundedFlatShiftRepresentative Y X → IsIso (α X hX)) :
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (htel : isFlatTelescope Y P),
      IsIso (α ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
        ⟨P, htel, Or.inl rfl⟩)
